title: jit doc add/remove append no event (violates INV-EVENT-LOG)
description:
`jit doc add` and `jit doc remove` mutate an issue's `documents` field and save it without appending any event to `events.jsonl`. Every other issue mutation path (`issue update`, `bulk_update`, dependency commands, template apply) appends an `issue_updated` event with the changed fields. This violates INV-EVENT-LOG (every state change appends an event).

Discovered by the code-review gate on faed8ffa, which flagged a documents entry in the issue file with no matching event.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `add_document_reference` and `remove_document_reference` (crates/jit/src/commands/document.rs) append an `issue_updated` event with `fields: ["documents"]` after saving the issue, mirroring the `issue.rs`/`bulk_update.rs` pattern.
- [hard] REQ-02: Tests cover both paths: after `jit doc add` and after `jit doc remove`, the last event in the log is `issue_updated` for that issue with `fields` containing `documents` (TestHarness-level tests).
- [hard] REQ-03: cargo fmt, clippy (zero warnings), and the full test suite pass.
